title: VIQI R8000 gravel-road current listing family
notes: Current exact-family indexing identifies the VIQI R8000 as a carbon-fiber gravel/all-terrain complete-bike option with Shimano Ultegra R8000 mechanical 22-speed, equivalent to 2x11. It does not publish a carbon grade or lay-up, controlled complete-bike weight, fork construction or manufacturer maximum tire clearance; a 40 mm wheel option is rim depth, not clearance.
